senses.gloss: f. (ἐμπορία) journey for business, traffic, trade; also merchandise. כלי א׳ merchant’s implements (straps, poles &c. for carrying goods).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:2">B. Mets. II, 2</cite> <he>כלי א׳ אינו וכ׳</he> merchant’s implements (if found) need not be publicly announced (for return to the owner).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 23b:10">Ib. 23ᵇ</cite> sq.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:2:1">Y. B. Mets. II, beg. 8ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 2:1">Tosef. ib. II, 1</cite> (definit. of our w.).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 109:14">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVIII, 20</cite> <he>התקין א׳ שלו</he> arranged his journey with the caravan. [Also <he>אַנְכּוֹרְיָה</he>.]
